epigraph: The stone does not ask permission to fall.
vignette: The ground shakes. Dust rises from the cracked earth. A Juggernaut steps into the square. It is not a man. It is iron and hunger given weight. The Umbral scribe draws the lines in ash and blood. The shape hardens. It moves forward. It does not look back. A Verdant wall of glass stands in its path. The Juggernaut hits the wall. The glass shatters. The shards fly. The Juggernaut takes the cell. Its power, Trample, ripples outward. The cell beside the wall cracks. A second Verdant truth falls. The ground accepts the weight. The Juggernaut keeps moving. It cannot stop. To stop is to die. It eats the distance. It eats the opposition. The Umbral claim expands. The Verdant retreats into dust. The Juggernaut is momentum. It is the end of stillness. It leaves a scar of broken reality in its wake. The tower grows higher. The lower truths are buried under the weight of the fall.
codex_note: Trample demonstrates that kinetic conviction can shatter static permanence through lateral force propagation.
